title: Operations
description: Keep an installed setup healthy: update it, verify changes, diagnose failures, and plan for additional hosts.

sections.title: Maintain a working setup
paragraphs: Use a short review, apply, and verify cycle. Understand the update boundary and rollback coverage before changing a machine that already works.

sections.title: Operate servers and multiple hosts
paragraphs: Use the headless path for Debian or Ubuntu servers and validate each host rather than assuming that a shared blueprint makes every environment identical.
